summary: Alcoa Corp filed an 8-K regarding Amendment No. 3 to its existing revolving credit facility with a syndicate of lenders and JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. The amendment extends the maturity date to June 27, 2028, and removes certain credit spread and sustainability adjustments. The aggregate commitments remain unchanged at $1.25 billion. The borrower paid 0.05% of each lender's commitment for participation. This is a routine credit agreement amendment with no change in facility size, no M&A, restructuring, or other special situation event. It merely refinances existing debt terms.
